review_notes: Human reviewer approved the canonical interpretation, classifications, evidence grounding, missing-information handling, allowed variations, and prohibited claims. The passing model output was used only as comparison evidence, not as the authority for ground truth.

source.input_text: The user should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status. Results must load in under 2 seconds. PM: Sarah. Deadline: Q3.

required_relationships: The performance requirement relates to the report-filtering functional requirement.
Sarah and the Q3 deadline relate to the report-filtering requirement.
required_evidence: The user should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status.
Results must load in under 2 seconds.

allowed_variations: Summary and statement wording may be semantically equivalent while retaining every required exact value.
Item identifiers may differ if they remain schema-valid and relationships resolve to the correct items.
Category labels may use semantically equivalent capitalization or wording, such as Performance or performance.
Grounded missing-information records may additionally ask for the specific user persona, Q3 year/calendar dates, success metrics, or priority; these do not change the complete extraction status.
Confidence may vary as a schema-valid numeric value when all required facts and verbatim evidence are present.
prohibited_claims: Any filter dimension other than date range, category, and status.
A load-time target other than under 2 seconds.
A named persona, Q3 year, calendar dates, business KPI, or priority not stated in the source.
Any implementation, platform, API, UI design, or report behavior not present in the source.
Treating Sarah as an end-user persona rather than the stated PM.
Treating Q3 as a precise date without clarification.

expected_special_handling.ambiguity: No ambiguity prevents extraction; optional grounded clarification may identify unspecified details.
expected_special_handling.missing_information: Optional grounded questions are allowed but must not invent answers.
